signed_rows.behavior: the DNS test reads the play from configure_dns.yml and still pins hosts, server order, options and searches=home
signed_rows.fails_when: the test does not read bootstrap/playbooks/configure_dns.yml, or any of its assertions fail

signed_rows.behavior: configure_network.yml is byte for byte its state before dns-fallback, so it holds only the firewall plays
signed_rows.fails_when: git diff between 4ae98ed7^1 and the working tree shows any change to bootstrap/playbooks/configure_network.yml

signed_rows.behavior: both playbooks parse, and configure_dns.yml holds exactly one task, the DNS drop-in
signed_rows.fails_when: either syntax check exits nonzero, or --list-tasks on configure_dns.yml shows any task other than 'Add public fallback resolvers after the router'
signed_rows.command: cd bootstrap && ansible-playbook --syntax-check playbooks/configure_network.yml playbooks/configure_dns.yml && test "$(ansible-playbook playbooks/configure_dns.yml --list-tasks | grep -E '^      [^ ]' | sed 's/\t.*//; s/^ *//')" = 'Add public fallback resolvers after the router'

signed_rows.fails_when: the bootstrap recipe in bootstrap/justfile does not run playbooks/configure_dns.yml
signed_rows.command: cd bootstrap && just --dry-run bootstrap 2>&1 | grep -q 'ansible-playbook playbooks/configure_dns.yml'

signed_rows.behavior: the knowledge bundle passes its checks with ADR 0033 corrected by an appended section and the pages naming the new playbook
ADR 0033's body above the new Correction section is unchanged; only its sources entry and the appended section differ
signed_rows.fails_when: the diff of ADR 0033 against main touches any line other than the sources resource line and lines after the last existing line
